data_and_evaluation_requirements.kind: resource/data planning request only; not runtime fields or a c5 schema extension
data_and_evaluation_requirements.mandatory_scope: Chinese and English must both be usable; English demo confirmed. English evaluation is mandatory and prioritized per Proposal; absent English evidence remains mandatory blocked.
data_and_evaluation_requirements.public_language_contract: 032 owns fixed work_language=zh|en and locale/translation provenance. Consumers do not invent fields or mutate c5.
data_and_evaluation_requirements.input_owner: 033 bilingual same-fact content; 032 fixed contract/source authority; W07 audited release
input_requirements: same facts, quantities, permissions, event timing and action consequences in zh/en; preserve information asymmetry
actual original/translation file hashes, object versions, each text own span/quote, source/target locale, translator/version and review provenance
original and translation keep structure_id, fact_root_ids, component_id, derivation links and connected group in the same split
language is never a random split defense; count unique causal structures separately from translated rows
accepted labels, class/evaluable coverage and source permissions verified in each language; translation does not automatically confer gold validity
evaluation_requirements: record actual train-language composition and report all metrics/denominators separately for zh and en; missing mandatory locale explicitly blocked
same-language model pairing retains exact input_hash checks; cross-language pairs retain their different hashes and use verified translation/fact groups
map localized evidence IDs back to actual source/translation anchors; paired agreement alone is not correctness
record label/applicability/evidence disagreement, retrieval/truncation effects, coverage/failures/cost by language; cluster paired uncertainty by shared causal group
pending_real_work: fixed bilingual source and translation metadata
audited paired zh/en data and language-specific gold
data_and_evaluation_requirements.evidence_boundary: TF-IDF English execution, numeric fixtures and a multilingual model name are not English quality evidence.
data_and_evaluation_requirements.resource_policy: Existing read-only audit remains point-in-time evidence; no installation, download, fee, model run or sealed test authorized by this plan.
